build_display_node: build a labgraph Display node that draws overlays and presents them in CV2 windows
create_display_config: create a DisplayConfig with target framerate, stats history size, and extension types
run_display_loop: run the display main loop that updates windows at a target framerate with perf tracking
review_display_handler_setup: review the Display node setup that initializes a DisplayHandler with key callback registration
test_exit_handling: test the Display node exit handling via stream signal, user signal, or ESC key press
